claims.text: Refractory hypotension, esp. pts on beta-blockers: inotropic + chronotropic effects not mediated through beta receptors
claims.quote: Any patient with refractory hypotension, especially those being treated with beta blockers, should be given glucagon because it has inotropic and chronotropic effects that are not mediated through beta receptors.

claims.text: Dose: 1–5 mg IV over 5 min (20–30 mcg/kg in children), then 5–15 mcg/min infusion
claims.quote: glucagon 1 to 5 mg IV over 5 minutes (20 to 30 mcg/kg in children) followed by a 5 to 15 mcg/minute infusion has been recommended.
Rapid administration of glucagon can cause vomiting.
